subject: Finalized travel plan + split-leg handoff for Novum exec workshop
messages:
From: Sara Morales <sara@travelsync.co>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Tom Benson <tbenson@novum.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft itineraries + split-leg options for Novum workshop (attached)

Diego / Laura —

Attached are two routing options for the Novum executive workshop (Dec 7–9). Option A keeps the full group on three large PNRs; Option B uses split legs to accommodate staggered arrivals and earlier departures for two execs. Key notes:

- Option A (group PNR): single shuttle pickup, but two passengers requested seat upgrades which would add ~$420.
- Option B (split legs): allows Marcus and Michael to take an earlier redeye home; creates two PNRs and a separate shuttle time at 08:30 for the afternoon arrivals.

I flagged potential visa check for one attendee with a non-US passport — Tom, can you confirm documents?

Attachments: Novum_MTG_manifest_v2.pdf, PNR_list.csv

Let me know which option you want me to finalize by EOD Monday (11/30). I can also lock seats once we confirm names for seat swaps.

Thanks,
Sara
TravelSync — Corporate Travel
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

From: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
To: Sara Morales <sara@travelsync.co>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com, michael_grant@redwood-inference.com, Tom Benson <tbenson@novum.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft itineraries + split-leg options for Novum workshop (attached)

Sara —

Thanks for the two options and the manifest. Quick responses below:

1) Go with Option B (split legs). We need earlier departures for Marcus and Michael on Dec 9 so they can get back to West Coast offices same day.

2) For seat upgrades: only approve upgrades for the three speakers (names in the attached CSV). Please *hold* on charging cards until I confirm with finance tomorrow morning.

3) Visa check: Tom — Novum will confirm whether the one attendee requires pre-clearance. If they need assistance we may need to swap carriers for that PNR.

4) Shuttle timing: set the arrival shuttle for Dec 7 at 14:15 for the larger group; add a private car option for the two execs landing at 11:50 (Marcus / Michael). Karen at GroundShuttle is copied on this thread for a quote.

Could you also split the seat map so we have one PNR for the main group and one PNR for Marcus/Michael + the two late-arrival consultants? If you can produce a quick summary with timings by tomorrow EOD that would help our ops lead.

--
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com | +1 510-555-0134

From: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft itineraries + split-leg options for Novum workshop (attached)

Diego / Sara —

Confirmed on Option B from my side. A few operational asks:

- Please ensure Marcus and Michael are assigned aisle seats (long day after travel). Marcus prefers row 7–10 if available.
- Can we avoid late evening connections for the main cohort — keep arrivals before 6pm local time.
- For the two consultants arriving later, route them on the same PNR as Marcus / Michael to simplify ground transport.

Sara — when you send the final summary, can you also include a short row-by-row seating plan and the shuttle confirmation number? That will let onsite check-in go faster.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Program Lead, Events | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com

Thanks team —

This looks good. Two quick confirmations from me before you finalize:

- Seat upgrades: only apply to the three speakers; do not apply to any Novum attendees unless Tom confirms budget approval.
- Private car for the early arrivals: OK to proceed, but please cap at $150/car. Karen — if you can confirm a vehicle within that range, approve and Diego will route payment.

If Sara can send the finalized manifest by EOD today with the seat map and PNRs I will sign off.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marcus Lin
